claim: READ_MAX_BYTES was removed from agent_toolset in favour of DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_BYTES
OpenTelemetry support depends on opentelemetry-api, a required dependency, and never on an OpenTelemetry SDK
Only True from confirm approves; any other answer refuses the call
By default requests time out after 10 minutes.
State-changing methods require confirm; read-only methods do not call confirm by default; confirm_reads protects selected reads and receives a before_read context with state None.
Installing the SDK installs HTTPX2 but no longer installs httpx or certifi; the aiohttp extra uses an HTTPX2-native transport without httpx-aiohttp.
Requests time out after 10 minutes by default
X.509 credential refreshBufferSeconds defaults to 1,200 seconds and is capped at half of the token's lifetime
Webhook verification default tolerance is 300 seconds, rejects timestamps too old or too far in the future, and requires webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers
include_tracing_api_key=True is required to put the tracing API key in serialized RunState.

UnixLocalSandboxClient passes the full host environment by default; inherit_host_environment=False restricts to a documented allowlist; a custom allowlist requires inherit_host_environment=False; HOME is the workspace root.
For local ShellTool and ApplyPatchTool approval is opt-in: needs_approval defaults to False.

Legacy sessions close after session_idle_timeout (default 1800 s) with nothing in flight; a long-running tool call is not interrupted and the countdown starts only when it finishes; the client then sees 404 Session not found; logged as "Session <id> idle timeout" at INFO.
The default SSE event cap is 1 MiB per event, configurable (None disables); streamable_http_client's parameters are url, http_client, terminate_on_close and max_sse_event_size.
Client retry loop is capped by input_required_max_rounds (default 10); exceeding it makes call_tool raise; state-only rounds sleep 50ms doubling to a 250ms ceiling.
Every @modelcontextprotocol/* package requires Node.js 20.

On 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP, aborting an in-flight client request closes that request's SSE response stream instead of POSTing notifications/cancelled; other transports/eras still send notifications/cancelled; custom transports opt in with hasPerRequestStream = true.
PrivateKeyJwtProvider signs a fresh assertion with a 300-second default lifetime, overridable with jwtLifetimeSeconds.
The DevTools integration stores captured data locally in .devtools/generations.json and automatically adds .devtools to your .gitignore file.
Telemetry is opt-out per call with telemetry: { isEnabled: false }; recordInputs/recordOutputs false stop inputs/outputs being recorded.
If telemetry.includeRuntimeContext is omitted, no runtime context properties are included in telemetry.
OIDC mode uses sensitive HTTP headers and zeroizes temporary credential buffers.
OIDC renewal failure fails closed with HTTP 502, and failed exchanges back off one second, doubling up to 30 seconds.
Standalone installers download from releases.openai.com by default and fall back to GitHub Releases; CODEX_INSTALLER_USE_RELEASES_OPENAI_COM=false (0/no also accepted) forces GitHub Releases.
